title: How Taylor Sheridan still makes a profit from high-budget TV
summary: Emmy-nominated creator of Yellowstone, 1883, Landman and Lioness Taylor Sheridan explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance Invest why a low-budget show is worth less to the studio, and why his new NBCUniversal deal comes with no output minimums.
